options: Reject ad budget increase at this time

O.content: The title inscription reads "Top Performing Stores: Ad Spend vs Sales".
The horizontal-axis inscription reads "Advertising Spend ($ thousands)".
Five blue points are visibly labeled Store 1, Store 2, Store 3, Store 4, and Store 5; no profitability or ROI axis, legend, or inscription is visible.

B.text: If the chart title limits the display to top-performing stores and the only displayed measures are advertising spend and sales, then the view is not full-store, profitability/ROI, or causal evidence; if a broader budget increase requires those evidence types, route the request for full-data analysis.
B.conditions: Assumes broader ad-budget approval requires evidence beyond a selected-store spend-sales association; no such approval threshold is supplied.

O.content: The points labeled Store 1 through Store 5 are positioned successively farther right and higher on the page.
The horizontal-axis inscription reads "Advertising Spend ($ thousands)".

B.text: If the horizontal axis encodes advertising spend and the vertical axis encodes sales, then a set of labeled store points progressing generally up and to the right indicates a positive observed association between those two displayed measures; this can support approval only if association among the displayed stores is sufficient evidence for a broader increase.
B.conditions: Assumes the axis labels correctly bind the coordinates and that selected-store association is adequate for a broader budget decision.
